answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each new agent id earn weight through a locked stake and a timed compute proof before it can vote. Reputation then spreads like saffron threads through a ledger: signed, reproducible tasks are the only fiber peers accept, and an attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake. Clone ids may wander in by the thousand, weightless as dust in a nebula, while honest work compounds into real influence epoch after epoch.
